observations: The second-topic case is committed tooling, mine: `--second-followed-issue` (f17fb4eb) creates a second Dispatch issue, has both sessions follow its topic beside the first, and publishes one comment there per window. Two details worth keeping: Dispatch refuses the create as a possible duplicate of the first followed issue, so the script passes `force: true` (internal/dispatch/api/issue_create.go), and the issue-order check now reads only the first issue's comments, since the order is read back from that issue's own subject. The default shape is unchanged with the flag off, which I checked with a run of its own.

The upgrade run is cheap enough to keep in every round: `--disruptions a --resume-plugins-from <main>` is about 90 seconds and it is the only thing that has caught a regression at the rollout transition.
